summary: Independently reviewed both editions against all eighteen paragraphs of the selected working Greek. Both preserve the thirteen rod groups, their differing conditions and proportions, negation, group separation, dialogue attribution, and distinct expressions of joy. The simplified edition retains the source content without importing later interpretations. The notes distinguish working-edition restorations, reported corrections, supplied letters, and physical losses; no concrete contradiction with the supplied evidence reports was identified. Acceptance is limited to fidelity to this working source and disclosure consistent with those reports, not authentication of unseen manuscripts, verification of external editions, or exhaustive collation.
